    The connected power of Galaxy

    Seamlessly pair and control Galaxy devices

    Nearby devices lets you connect and operate your Galaxy devices in an instant. Open the menu on Galaxy Book5 Pro 360 to link devices with a simple drag-and-drop, then launch intuitive features such as Multi Control and Storage Share between your phone, PC and Tab all from one connectivity hub.

    *To use the Nearby devices feature, phone, tablet, or PC must be signed into Samsung account, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth must be enabled, and the following conditions must be met.
    - Galaxy phones and tablets: One UI 7 or higher
    - Galaxy Books: The Nearby devices app needs to be installed from the Microsoft Store. Samsung Settings 6.0 or higher. Samsung Continuity Service 1.13 or higher
    **Discoverable devices:
    - Galaxy phones and tablets: One UI 7 or higher required for full functionality. If your phone or tablet has One UI 4.1.1 or higher and Continuity Service 1.2.27 or higher, only limited features are available.
    - Galaxy Books: Samsung Settings 6.0 or higher. Samsung Continuity Service 1.13 or higher
    - Samsung TVs (released in 2016 or later), Smart monitors, and projectors: Must be turned on and must have been connected to the phone/tablet at least once using Smart View or DeX.
    - Galaxy Buds, Watches (Galaxy Watch4 and above), ﬁtness bands, and Rings: Must be paired with the phone using Bluetooth. Galaxy Buds must be removed from the case or the case must be opened.
    ***Feature availability may vary by region and device model.

    Storage Share. Explore files across devices

    With Storage Share, enjoy the freedom of using the storage on your phone and PC as one. Browse photos and play videos stored on your phone, edit mobile content and import it in your projects directly on your PC — no file downloading required.

    *Each device must be signed in to same Samsung account and must have both Wi-Fi and Bluetooth turned on. Requires updated Galaxy phones and tablets with One UI 7 or higher and kernal version 5.15 or higher and Galaxy Book2 or later(Intel) and Galaxy Book4 or later(Arm) and Samsung Smart TV models including U8000 and above released after 2025.
    **Feature availability may vary by region and device model.

(OS: Windows 10 2004 version or higher, Bluetooth driver: Intel 22.50.02 or higher, Wi-Fi driver: Intel 22.50.07 or higher).     Frequently Asked Questions

    How are Galaxy Book5 Pro and Galaxy Book5 Pro 360 different? Which model is good for me?

Both are great for professional tasks and intensive workloads.If you are looking for a high-end, portable laptop, Galaxy Book5 Pro is ideal for you. It comes in 16" and 14" sizes. The 14" model weighs just 1.23kg with a 11.6mm profile, making it easy to carry on the go.If you need a laptop for note-taking, design and creative pursuits, the 2-in-1 Galaxy Book5 Pro 360 with S Pen support is right for you.

Galaxy Book5 Pro supports fast charging — simply plug in and get up to 35% charge in just about 30 minutes on the 16" model and up to 41% on the 14" model.

    *Based on results from internal lab tests for local video playback time conducted by Samsung. Battery capacity, video runtime, battery life on a full charge and amount of charge that can be charged in 30 minutes vary by model and configuration.**Please refer to the product page for detailed restrictions of each feature and specification differences between Galaxy Book5 Pro 16" and Galaxy Book5 Pro 14".

    Does Galaxy Book5 Pro have a touchscreen?

    Galaxy Book5 Pro features a 3K(2880x1800) WQXGA+ high-resolution Dynamic AMOLED 2X touchscreen. The display supports intuitive multi-touch gestures and up to 120Hz refresh rate for a smooth and fluid user experience.Galaxy Book5 Pro is available in two sizes — 16" and 14". Models in both sizes are equipped with displays with identical specifications.

    *Screen size is measured diagonally as a full rectangle without accounting for the rounded corners. Actual viewable area is less due to the rounded corners.**The Dynamic AMOLED 2X display used in Galaxy Book5 Pro has received the "Eye Care" certification from SGS based on its ability to drastically reduce the harmful effects of blue light. More information of this certification can be found on www.sgs.com/performance.

    C'est un bon ordinateur. Il est facile à manipuler, et à changer ses paramètres. J'adore que je peux utiliser son écran tactile quand je dois lire des textes. L'I.A. aide beaucoup pour mes cours. J'adore que pour utiliser les raccourcis des touches F1 il faut d'abord utiliser la touche FN. C'est très pratique. Bien sûr il faut faire attention aux 2 différents paramètres, celui de Microsoft/Windows et celui de Samsung. Mon ancien ordinateur était un Asus avec écran tactile, cette ordinateur est un peu différent car c'est comme un MacBook mais il est très utile quand tu es en étude supérieure. Je suis à l'aise quand j'utilise l'ordinateur à l'université car je n'ai pas de problème. Bien que c'est chiant que je dois le charger en cours de journée (genre quand c'est autours de 14h-14h30, j'ai utilisé l'ordinateur pendant 5 heures d'affilée) mais ça va j'ai une batterie externe adaptable aux ordinateurs portables. Cette ordinateur se charge rapidement surtout qu'il se décharge lentement (j'attends que ce soit autour de 60% à 40% de charge pour le recharger car l'icône de batterie montre que c'est 20% et c'est seulement après 5h30 utilisation).     Le Galaxy Book Pro 360 est un ordinateur portable que j’apprécie énormément au quotidien. Son design élégant, sa finesse et sa prise en main en font un appareil très agréable à utiliser, aussi bien en mode PC qu’en mode tablette. La suite logicielle Samsung est un vrai point fort : l’interaction entre le PC et le smartphone est fluide, intuitive et parfaitement intégrée. On sent clairement l’écosystème pensé pour fonctionner ensemble. L’écran est tout simplement incroyable : lumineux, précis, avec des couleurs magnifiques. Un vrai plaisir pour le travail créatif, le multimédia ou simplement la navigation. Autre point très appréciable : il est totalement silencieux, ce qui renforce le confort d’utilisation. La frappe du clavier est très agréable, confortable même sur de longues sessions, et le rétro-éclairage est bien dosé, pratique et élégant, aussi bien de jour que de nuit. Côté regrets, j’aurais aimé : une option avec 32 Go de RAM pour être totalement à l’aise sur les usages les plus exigeants, une capacité de stockage M.2 plus grande, ou au minimum la présence d’un slot supplémentaire pour pouvoir l’augmenter facilement. Malgré ces points, cela reste un excellent ordinateur portable, polyvalent, premium et très bien pensé. Je recommande sans hésiter le Galaxy Book Pro 360, surtout pour celles et ceux qui utilisent déjà l’écosystème Samsung.

    [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] What can I say, from the screen to the battery life, this laptop is perfect for my daily and travel needs. Powerful enough for editing and producing my YouTube videos and with enough battery for browsing and enjoying watching the vibrant screen all day without the need to recharge. The 16" screen trumps the 14" for when I'm working with Excel or Word and having the Number Pad really adds to the productivity you can get from the Book5 Pro. Having previously seen the benefits of Windows Hello, I was a bit disappointed that it didn't come with facial recognition, but then finding out how simple and easy signing in was when logging in with the fingerprint sensor, any disappointment vanished. Another big plus for me, as I tend to lounge with the laptop on my legs, was that there doesn't seem to be the same temperature build up that I have experienced with other laptops, along with the quiet running and lack of fan noise, I find it extremely usable. A huge trackpad, fast processor, large storage, long battery life, all the ports I will ever need and a camera that makes video calling a breeze, this Book5 Pro ticks all of my boxes and after purchasing it, I have no regrets whatsoever. A huge recommendation from me and if, like me, you are a Samsungphile, it works seamlessly with all of my other devices, from my S24 Ultra and transferring files to streaming to my TV's, excellent.

    PC Storage : 512 GB | Colour : Grey

    L’écran tactile est ultra fluide, la résolution est excellente et l’appareil se montre assez vif dans l’ensemble. La batterie semble tenir ses promesses et le design, sobre et élégant en aluminium est apprécié. Le clavier aurait pu être un peu plus grand je pense au vu de l’espace disponible, et l’ajout d’une barre de tâches tactile aurait été un vrai plus. Le manque de connectiques peut également se révéler frustrant selon les usages, aussi, plus de choix quant au processeur et a la mémoire serait GRANDEMENT apprécié. Cependant, plusieurs dysfonctionnements viennent entacher l’usage au quotidien. Copilot présente des bugs récurrents au démarrage, le pavé tactile quant à lui bug énormément (bloquant parfois l’utilisation pendant plusieurs secondes !!) ce qui devient vite agaçant. À trois reprises, le PC a complètement freezé nécessitant un redémarrage forcé. Lorsqu’on l’utilise dans un cadre professionnel, il montre des signes de faiblesse : ralentissements, perte de fluidité, et baisse de performance ( tout ceci indépendamment du niveau de batterie ou du mode) Cela limite sérieusement son efficacité dans un contexte exigeant. En résumé, ce PC présente de belles qualités sur le plan du design, de la fluidité tactile et de l’autonomie, mais ces atouts sont ternis par des dysfonctionnements techniques qui nuisent à son utilisation. Dommage, car avec un peu plus de stabilité et de fiabilité, il aurait pu être une vraie référence dans sa catégorie.

    [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Gradually converting to Samsung, fold phone, watch, ring, tablet, laptop was next! The laptop is really slim, and feels really well built with its metal chassis. The Galaxy Book5 Pro supports copilot+ pc and galaxy ai features which just seems to get better and better each day. I can easily multitask word documents, or browser pages. I haven't had an opportunity to test the battery life, it just doesn't seem to consume battery, but I do not believe I have really put it to the test. It will come travelling over the ski season, and I will be able to provide further feedback after that, but in general it coped really well with watching / streaming videos, writing documents, browsing. Finally, the integration between other Samsung products is just sublime. Using the tablet as a second screen just worked so easily. Putting the Galaxy Buds3 Pro's in my ears then just linked to the laptop. The One UI works (and keeps improving with updates). So far - amazing!

    PC Storage : 512 GB | Colour : Grey

    The Samsung Galaxy Book5 Pro is a sleek, portable laptop designed with an active lifestyle in mind, like mine. At first glance, it impresses with its slim profile and solid, premium finish. Available in two sizes – 14 and 16 inches – I personally chose the 16, perfect for gaming and movies. Despite its size, it offers lightness and mobility without compromising on performance. I use the 16-inch version and I am absolutely delighted with it. Under the hood, the Galaxy Book5 Pro hides the latest Intel Core Ultra 7 processor with Intel Arc graphics. This configuration allows for efficient performance of demanding tasks, from video editing to multitasking office work. The laptop runs smoothly and responsively, and thanks to its modern architecture, it provides high energy efficiency. Stunning display – which I love The dynamic AMOLED 2X screen with 3K resolution is a real gem of this model. The touch panel impresses with its intense colors and deep blacks, and the 120 Hz refresh rate guarantees exceptionally smooth animation. Additionally, anti-reflective technology makes the image legible in all lighting conditions. My 16-inch model is distinguished by a larger subwoofer, which translates into a richer, more spatial sound. This is a big plus for people who value sound quality when watching movies or listening to music. Another improvement is the precise touchpad with an adaptive system for rejecting accidental touches, which significantly improves the comfort of use. Samsung has not forgotten about modern solutions in terms of connectivity - the Galaxy Book5 Pro supports Wi-Fi 7, which ensures an ultra-fast connection to the Internet. The long battery life is also worth noting - up to 25 hours on a single charge! This is an ideal solution for people who often work on the go. So it is perfect for me because I travel a lot and it is great for this. The Galaxy Book5 Pro is a well-designed, light and efficient laptop that will meet the expectations of even demanding users. The slim design, powerful specs, brilliant display and long-lasting battery make it one of the best choices in its class. If you are looking for a laptop that can keep up with your fast-paced lifestyle, this model will definitely not disappoint you!
    I recommended this product.

The Book5 Pro sports a good sized keyboard as well as a numpad which is really useful when working with figures and for use with media editing. The keys are easy to press and responsive with no drops and whilst some keys are a little smaller such as the enter on the num pad, these are quickly got used. Graphics wise, ie the amazing AMOLED screen, things are really good. Great brightness, colours and definition allowing good and true to life images and videos to be show. Likewise tha laptop is really good with modern games such as Indiana Jones and the Great Circle, providing good quick gameplay and defined graphics and cinematics. The screen is also touch sensitive which is very useful. Whilst having a good large desktop screen, I find myself being able to use the Book5 Pro screen a lot more due to its quality. There is a very large track pad which allows for use with the left or right hand easily and it is really responsive and allows for fine detailed movements as well as fast travel across the screen. The Book5 Pro is nice and slim and fits nicely in my photographic case along with my camera gear, or slips nicely into my backpack without taking up much space. There are two USB C ports of which one can be used for charging the laptop, as well as a USB A port, an HDMI port, a headphone jack and a microsd card slot. The card slot is great for my action camera cards to be able to offload the footage and edit. Sound is where I would say things are let down a little as it is not as rich or with base or powerful as one would expect for such a premium laptop, however you can improve things a little with the Dolby controller settings. Battery life is great, lasting all day when editing and playing back videos and allows still for some gaming without the need to charge, so use on the plane or when travelling is great. The included charger is quick, compact and small. Overall a great laptop for every day use at home and when travelling.
    I recommended this product.
